verdict.rationale: Superhuman's Split Inbox lets users design their own categories such as "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team", dividing the inbox into areas of focus. Auto Labels classify mail automatically, separate marketing, and can become inbox tabs. A community user independently notes promotional mail goes to an 'other' folder. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ordering or prioritizing splits for triage sequence, custom AI Auto Labels being limited to Business/Enterprise plans, and deeper hands-on corroboration of the split workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: in Superhuman Mail, you can design your own categories: like "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team".
splitting your inbox allows you to divide your inbox into different areas of focus
you can make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts, and then split your inbox into tabs using these custom Auto Labels.
Superhuman AI will automatically separate marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates, so you can respond faster to what matters most.
you can focus on a specific topic — and get through emails of the same type, at the same time.
Superhuman puts promotional mail into an 'other' folder
